messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up 1 72h to Luma Diagnostics QBR. Need slide leads, one-line exec ask, and any last-minute enablement wins to show lift. Renewal window FY26 Q1. Main concerns: onboarding velocity + delayed data connector. Can folks claim slides?
Omar (Success Ops): I'll take the health & onboarding slide. Will pull cohort-level activation and time-to-first-success.
Sophie (AE): I can do renewal position + commercial asks. Thinking: propose a targeted pilot extension vs pricing credits. Will draft both.
Evan (Solutions Eng): I'll own integration status + blockers. Current blocker: connector v2 fails on staging with auth handshake. Can someone paste the error trace?
Maya (CSM): Error trace from support: "AuthHandshakeError: 401 token exchange failed". Ticket CUS-8192. Also note: cohort alpha shows 14% drop in completed workflows last week.
qbr-bot: Template reminder 1 QBR checklist: 1 slide customer context, 1 slide health, 1 slide asks, 1 slide risks+plan. Use naming: Luma_QBR_<owner>.pptx
infra-bot: FYI 1 deployed a hotfix to analytics pipeline last night, ingestion latency reduced from 38m to 6m. Could be why activation looks better for some cohorts.
Omar (Success Ops): Adding MAU + activation funnel as small charts. Quick poll: raw numbers or % delta for execs?
Sophie (AE): % delta with a $ impact callout. Execs want $$s.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Pasted brief snippet in deck notes and added link to error logs: https://internal.logs/CUS-8192. Asking eng-oncall to triage token refresh window.
Maya (CSM): Slide owner checklist (paste into notes):
```
- Owner name
- 1-line slide summary
- 1 concise exec ask (action + desired outcome)
- 2 supporting bullets (metric + impact)
- 1 mitigation / next step
```
Sophie (AE): Drafting two asks in the thread:
Option 1: 12-month renewal at current rate with guaranteed roadmap delivery for connector parity in Q2.
Option 2: 6-month pilot extension with 10% credit and prioritized engineering sprints for connectors.
Omar (Success Ops): I prefer Option 2 (pilot) but with a clear acceptance criteria table. Will add acceptance bullets to my slide.
Evan (Solutions Eng): For the tech slide Ill include ETA for fix (48h to identify root, 7 days for patch), plus workaround (manual token refresh).
Maya (CSM): Dry run scheduled 09:30 tomorrow. Please upload your finished slide and confirm in thread by EOD today. I'll assemble and circulate 2 hours before dry run.
Sophie (AE): Uploading renewal slide now. File name: Luma_QBR_Sophie.pptx
Omar (Success Ops): Uploaded onboarding slide and CSV asset. File name: Luma_QBR_Omar.pptx
Evan (Solutions Eng): Uploaded tech slide and linked logs. File name: Luma_QBR_Evan.pptx
Maya (CSM): Thanks team 1 last ask 1 make your exec ask quantifiable (impact or timeline). I'll finalize speaker order and send calendar invites for the dry run. :rocket:
